0022600087.text: Both the Charlotte Hornets and Brooklyn Nets open their 2026-27 seasons with this regular-season game in Brooklyn, where the Hornets are the visitors. Charlotte is listed as day-to-day with calf and hamstring issues for Coby White, Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, and with knee and elbow issues for Kylan Boswell and Moussa Diabate, all five of whom are game-time decisions, while Brooklyn is without Joshua Jefferson, who is out with a back issue. The Hornets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-86 win in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Charlotte a 60% chance to win.
